Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: extremely detailed premium home-appliance campaign product photography scene, landscape 3:2 composition, ideally 2400 x 1600. Create a photoreal matching pair of high-end graphite front-loading appliances: a washing machine on LEFT foreground and a matching tumble dryer on RIGHT, slightly behind and 8 percent smaller due to real perspective. Both are standalone floor units, same real-world size about 60 cm wide by 85 cm tall, normal consumer front-loader proportions, no tall industrial bodies. Both stand on the SAME perfectly level shallow cool pearl-grey limestone display base with rounded corners; base is 3 cm tall, barely raised, NOT a thick pedestal. Near-frontal view with just 10 degrees of three-quarter perspective, straight verticals and physically accurate symmetry. Washing machine is the primary object, with beautiful circular glass door, precisely machined satin silver rim, extremely realistic brushed stainless steel inner drum with crisp perforations and lifter paddles clearly visible behind slightly smoked glass; no black featureless hole. The dryer has similarly immaculate circular glass door with a different plausible drum interior. Graphite brushed metal panels, subtle rounded edges, a clean narrow glossy black control strip and one small restrained metallic control knob each; no interface gibberish, no readable display text. Real manufacturing details: panel gaps, rubber seals, realistic specular highlights, tiny material texture, premium tactile finish. Soft neutral studio key light from upper right, broad fill light to reveal the dark drum, gentle crisp edge separation, carefully balanced contrast. Whole group and base fully visible inside canvas with at least 9 percent clean safety margin on all sides, no cut-off feet or corners. Product grouping fills 80% canvas width. OPAQUE perfectly smooth cool pearl-grey studio backdrop exactly #f1f2f3 at every outer edge, no visible horizon, no hard wall/floor seam. The outermost 8% of all four edges is plain uniform #f1f2f3 without any objects or shadows, to blend seamlessly with a website. Realistic physically accurate contact shadows exist immediately underneath the appliances and display base, confined to the middle of the canvas. No alpha cutout; preserve genuine photographic reflections and shadows. Advertising illustration of a premium appliance category, no exact product model claim. No logos, no names, no letters, no watermarks, no blue LEDs, no green, no colored lighting, no orange, no extra appliances, no stacked units, no plumbing, no warped circles, no distorted geometry. It must look like high-resolution professional product photography, not a toy or plastic 3D sketch.
